description: The pie chart represents the distribution of character types in RoleplayPref, which is divided into three primary categories: Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters. Virtual Characters make up the largest portion, followed by Custom Characters, and then Real Characters. Within these primary categories, there are 13 subcategories, including Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, Game Characters, Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, Influencers, and one subcategory that is not labeled in the image. The chart does not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any visual emphasis on specific slices. The segments are ordered by size, with Virtual Characters being the largest, followed by Custom Characters, and then Real Characters.
